@everyone 

A quick note if you are minting with ETRNL in our marketplace. 

ETERNL now has an option to SUBMIT a transaction manually in the transactions page.

(DO NOT CLICK THAT MANUALLY) Our system will submit it automatically.

Some cases ETERNL does not update our marketplace after signing a transaction, in which case we cannot process the order. If this happens please open a support ticket with the ETERNL version, browser version and hardware wallet type if you use one. 

For the time being you can use a different wallet to mint. (edited)
